preconditions.expression: isinstance(grid, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in grid) and all(isinstance(cell, int) and cell in {0, 1} for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: grid is a list of lists where each cell is either 0 or 1

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(grid) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: grid is an N x N matrix

postconditions.description: return_value is -1 if no water or land exists, otherwise it is a non-negative integer

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or all(any(abs(i - x) + abs(j - y) <= return_value for x in range(len(grid)) for y in range(len(grid)) if grid[x][y] == 1) for i in range(len(grid)) for j in range(len(grid)) if grid[i][j] == 0)
postconditions.description: return_value is the maximum Manhattan distance from any water cell to the nearest land cell
